card.name: Words inside all-caps warning headings
card.fires_on: Words and word parts that come just before an all-caps continuation, as in boxed warning titles. Examples are 'and' between capitalized terms, 'QTc', and the start of 'contraindicated'.

modes.label: 'and' in caps headings
modes.description: The word 'and' joining two all-caps terms in a table or warning title.

modes.label: QTc in warnings
modes.description: The 'c' ending QT in boxed warning titles about QT interval.

modes.description: The 'contr' piece at the start of 'contraindicated' after 'also' or 'are'.
